description: Use this when the user shares a web page (product page, landing page, article) to use as context for writing their content. XcutAI reads the page and stores its text on a canvas. Up to about 3 credits. Returns a short preview. Do not use for social media post links (use xcut_import_post).

canvas_id.description: Optional. Leave it out unless the user names a canvas: XcutAI then uses their "From AI apps" canvas. Ids come from xcut_list_canvases.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

name: xcut_import_website
title: Import a website
